Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Level Start
Fields.Description: Load level (0–20) where the draw-distance scale starts moving from Scale Start toward Scale End. 21 = never (scale stays at Scale Start).

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Level End
Fields.Description: Load level where the draw-distance scale reaches Scale End and stays there. If equal to Level Start, the scale jumps to Scale End at that level.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Scale Start
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's draw distance at load levels below Level Start.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Scale End
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's draw distance at Level End and above.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Level Start
Fields.Description: Load level (0–20) where the shadow draw-distance scale starts moving from Scale Start toward Scale End. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Level End
Fields.Description: Load level where the shadow draw-distance scale reaches Scale End and stays there. If equal to Level Start, the scale jumps to Scale End at that level.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Scale Start
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's shadow draw distance at load levels below Level Start.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Scale End
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's shadow draw distance at Level End and above.
